```{r, include = FALSE}
year <- params$year
month <- params$month

month_name <- sprintf("%04d_%02d", year, month)

input_file <- file.path(as.character(year), paste0(sprintf("%04d%02d", year, month), "_C.csv"))

df <- fread(input_file)

df$TIMESTAMP <- as.POSIXct( paste(df$TIMESTAMP, "00:00"), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")

full_time <- data.frame(
  TIMESTAMP = seq(min(df$TIMESTAMP),
                  max(df$TIMESTAMP),
                  by = "30 mins")
)

df <- merge(full_time, df, by = "TIMESTAMP", all.x = TRUE)


# data formatting for flag plots
# Ensure flags are character first
df$co2_flux.flag <- as.character(df$co2_flux.flag)
df$ch4_flux.flag <- as.character(df$ch4_flux.flag)
df$H.flag <- as.character(df$H.flag)
df$LE.flag <- as.character(df$LE.flag)


# Then assign factor with explicit levels
df$co2_flux.flag <- factor(df$co2_flux.flag, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4","5"))
df$ch4_flux.flag <- factor(df$ch4_flux.flag, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4","5"))

df$H.flag <- factor(df$H.flag, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4","5"))
df$LE.flag <- factor(df$LE.flag, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4","5"))

#df$co2_flux.flag <- as.factor(df$co2_flux.flag)
#df$ch4_flux.flag <- as.factor(df$ch4_flux.flag)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

df$G = (df$SHF_6_37_1_1_1.c + df$SHF_6_37_2_1_1.c)/2  # SOIL HEAT FLUX

df <- df %>% mutate(SD_cm = ifelse(is.na(SD_10_99_1_1_1.c),NA,
      (SD_10_99_1_1_1.c ) * 100 ))  # adjust and convert from m to cm - SNOW DEPTH

df <- df %>% mutate(sonic_c = sonic_temperature - 273.15) # - SONIC TEMP

#df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(air_pressure)) %>% mutate(air_pressure_kpa = air_pressure / 1000) # -SONIC PRESSURE


df$Rn <- df$LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c + df$SWIN_6_10_1_1_1.c -      # Compute net radiation 
         df$LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c - df$SWOUT_6_11_1_1_1.c


df$shf_avg = rowMeans(
  df[, c("SHF_6_37_1_1_1.c", "SHF_6_37_2_1_1.c")],     # Compute SHF safely with fallback 
  na.rm = TRUE
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(c(SWC_12_36_1_1_1.c, SWC_12_36_1_2_1.c, SWC_12_36_1_3_1.c), ~ .x * 100))   # convert to %

# Standardize air pressure across sensor change
df$air_pressure <- ifelse(
  df$TIMESTAMP < as.POSIXct("2026-04-28 01:30:00", tz = "UTC"),
  df$air_p_mean.c,
  df$PA_4_2_1_1_1.c
)

df_month <- make_week_index(df)
df_month <- make_biweek_index(df_month)
```

# TIMESTAMP CHECK WITH RPOT/SWIN

```{r, echo=F}

# WEEKLY DIURNAL RADIATION
df_month$hour <- as.numeric(format(df_month$TIMESTAMP, "%H"))
df_month$year <- as.numeric(format(df_month$TIMESTAMP, "%Y"))
df_month$month <- as.numeric(format(df_month$TIMESTAMP, "%m"))

make_weekly_radiation_diel <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    group_by(year, month, week_in_month, hour) %>%
    summarise(
      SWIN_mean = ifelse(
        all(is.na(SWIN_6_10_1_1_1)),
        NA_real_,
        median(SWIN_6_10_1_1_1, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SWIN_sd = ifelse(
        sum(!is.na(SWIN_6_10_1_1_1)) < 2,
        NA_real_,
        sd(SWIN_6_10_1_1_1, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      rpot_mean = ifelse(
        all(is.na(rpot)),
        NA_real_,
        median(rpot, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      rpot_sd = ifelse(
        sum(!is.na(rpot)) < 2,
        NA_real_,
        sd(rpot, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

radiation_diel_week <- make_weekly_radiation_diel(df_month)
```

```{R, echo = F}

for (w in sort(unique(radiation_diel_week$week_in_month))) {

  p <- radiation_diel_week %>%
    dplyr::filter(week_in_month == w) %>%
    ggplot() +

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        x = hour,
        ymin = SWIN_mean - SWIN_sd,
        ymax = SWIN_mean + SWIN_sd
      ),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(x = hour, y = SWIN_mean, color = "SWIN"),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(x = hour, y = rpot_mean, color = "rpot"),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 3)
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste("Toolik - Radiation Diel - Week", w),
      x = "Hour of Day",
      y = "Radiation (W/m²)",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_bw()

  print(p)
}
```

###ENERGY BALANCE

```{r, echo=F}

# ============================================================
# ENERGY BALANCE
# ============================================================

both_missing <- is.na(df_month$SHF_6_37_1_1_1.c) &
                is.na(df_month$SHF_6_37_2_1_1_1.c)

df_month$shf_avg[both_missing] <- 0

df_month$met <- df_month$Rn - df_month$shf_avg

df_month$flux <- df_month$H.c + df_month$LE.c


# Only use complete EB observations
eb_data <- df_month %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(met),
    !is.na(flux)
  )


# ============================================================
# ENERGY BALANCE PLOT
# ============================================================

if (nrow(eb_data) < 2) {

  eb_month <- ggplot() +
    labs(
      x = expression("Rn - G  (W m"^-2*")"),
      y = expression("H + LE  (W m"^-2*")"),
      title = "Toolik - Monthly Energy Balance"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      label = "No valid energy balance data",
      size = 5
    ) +
    theme_bw()

} else {

  mod <- lm(
    flux ~ met,
    data = eb_data
  )

  slope <- coef(mod)["met"]
  r2 <- summary(mod)$r.squared


  cat(
    "Slope:", slope,
    "\nR²:", r2, "\n"
  )


  # ============================================================
  # DYNAMIC ENERGY BALANCE LIMITS
  # ============================================================

  eb_values <- c(
    eb_data$met,
    eb_data$flux
  )

  eb_values <- eb_values[is.finite(eb_values)]

  if (length(eb_values) > 0) {

    eb_range <- range(eb_values)

    eb_pad <- diff(eb_range) * 0.05

    if (eb_pad == 0) {
      eb_pad <- max(abs(eb_range[1]) * 0.05, 1)
    }

    eb_limits <- c(
      eb_range[1] - eb_pad,
      eb_range[2] + eb_pad
    )

  } else {

    eb_limits <- c(-1, 1)

  }


  eb_month <- ggplot(
    eb_data,
    aes(
      x = met,
      y = flux,
      color = factor(week_in_month)
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.7,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      color = "black",
      se = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red"
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    coord_fixed(
      ratio = 1,
      xlim = eb_limits,
      ylim = eb_limits
    ) +

    labs(
      x = expression("Rn - G  (W m"^-2*")"),
      y = expression("H + LE  (W m"^-2*")"),
      color = "Week",
      title = "Toolik - Monthly Energy Balance"
    ) +

    annotate(
      "text",
      x = eb_limits[2],
      y = eb_limits[1],
      label = paste0(
        "Slope = ", round(slope, 3),
        "\nR² = ", round(r2, 3)
      ),
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 4
    ) +

    theme_bw()
}

eb_month
```

#WIND COMPARISON - SONIC VS. YOUNG

```{r, echo=F}

# ============================================================
# WIND 1:1 COMPARISON PLOTTER
#
# Before 2026-04-26 17:00 UTC:
#   wind_speed       = Sonic
#   WS_16_33_1_1_1   = Sonic
#   max_wind_speed   = Sonic
#   MWS_16_34_1_1_1  = Sonic
#   wind_dir         = Sonic
#   WD_20_35_1_1_1   = Sonic
#
# After 2026-04-26 17:00 UTC:
#   wind_speed       = RMYOUNG
#   WS_16_33_1_1_1   = Sonic
#   max_wind_speed   = RMYOUNG
#   MWS_16_34_1_1_1  = Sonic
#   wind_dir         = RMYOUNG
#   WD_20_35_1_1_1   = Sonic
#
# Therefore, only data AFTER the transition are used for
# the RMYOUNG vs Sonic 1:1 comparisons.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# FUNCTION: GET VALID TWO-INSTRUMENT COMPARISON DATA
# Automatically skips months before both instruments are active
# ============================================================

wind_compare_data <- function(df, rmy_col, sonic_col,
                              date = "2026-04-26 17:00:00") {

  transition <- as.POSIXct(date, tz = "UTC")

  # Check that required columns exist
  if (!all(c("TIMESTAMP", rmy_col, sonic_col) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Keep only the period when RMYOUNG and Sonic are separate
  # instruments AND both measurements are present
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      TIMESTAMP > transition,
      !is.na(.data[[rmy_col]]),
      !is.na(.data[[sonic_col]])
    )

  # Skip if there is no valid comparison period/data
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  return(df_plot)
}


# ============================================================
# WIND SPEED
# Color = deviation between RMYOUNG and Sonic
# ============================================================

df_wind <- wind_compare_data(
  df_month,
  "wind_speed",
  "WS_16_33_1_1_1"
)

if (!is.null(df_wind)) {
  
  # Signed difference: Sonic - RMYOUNG
  df_wind$wind_speed_diff <-
    df_wind$WS_16_33_1_1_1 - df_wind$wind_speed
  
  wind_ws_11 <- ggplot(
    df_wind,
    aes(
      x = wind_speed,
      y = WS_16_33_1_1_1,
      color = wind_speed_diff
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    
    geom_abline(
      intercept = 0,
      slope = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "blue",
      mid = "grey90",
      high = "red",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "Sonic - RMYOUNG (m/s)"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = "Toolik - Wind Speed Comparison",
      x = "RMYOUNG Wind Speed (m/s)",
      y = "Sonic Wind Speed (m/s)"
    ) +
    
    theme_bw()
  
 
}

# ============================================================
# WIND DIRECTION
# Color = angular deviation between RMYOUNG and Sonic
# ============================================================

df_dir <- wind_compare_data(
  df_month,
  "wind_dir",
  "WD_20_35_1_1_1"
)

if (!is.null(df_dir)) {
  
  # Signed shortest angular difference: -180 to +180 degrees
  df_dir$direction_diff <- (
    (df_dir$WD_20_35_1_1_1 - df_dir$wind_dir + 180) %% 360
  ) - 180
  
  wind_dir_11 <- ggplot(
    df_dir,
    aes(
      x = wind_dir,
      y = WD_20_35_1_1_1,
      color = direction_diff
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    
    geom_abline(
      intercept = 0,
      slope = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "blue",
      mid = "grey90",
      high = "red",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-180, 180),
      breaks = seq(-180, 180, by = 45),
      name = "Sonic - RMYOUNG (°)"
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 360),
      breaks = seq(0, 360, by = 45)
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 360),
      breaks = seq(0, 360, by = 45)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = "Toolik - Wind Direction Comparison",
      x = "RMYOUNG Wind Direction (°)",
      y = "Sonic Wind Direction (°)"
    ) +
    
    theme_bw()
  
  
}

 wind_ws_11
 wind_dir_11
```

```{r, echo=F}
# ============================================================
# SONIC ANEMOMETER WIND ROSE
# ============================================================

df_wind_sonic <- df_month %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(wind_speed),
    !is.na(wind_dir)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    ws = as.numeric(wind_speed),
    wd = as.numeric(wind_dir)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(ws),
    is.finite(wd)
  )

if (nrow(df_wind_sonic) == 0) {

  plot.new()
  title("Toolik - Sonic Anemometer Wind Rose")
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No valid sonic wind data")

} else {

  windRose(
    df_wind_sonic,
    ws = "ws",
    wd = "wd",
    paddle = FALSE,
    key.position = "bottom",
    main = "Toolik - Sonic Anemometer Wind Rose"
  )
```

# TOMST SLUMP
```{R, echo=F}
# =========================================================================
# TMS NETWORK MONTHLY QC
# =========================================================================
df_filtered <- df_month


# Common styling
lbl_y_temp <- expression("Temperature ("*degree*C*")")
lbl_y_vwc  <- expression("Soil Moisture VWC (m"^3*"/m"^3*")")

color_map <- c(
  "Center" = "black",
  "East"   = "firebrick",
  "West"   = "dodgerblue4",
  "North"  = "forestgreen",
  "South"  = "gold3"
)


# =========================================================================
# TMS PLOT FUNCTION
# Skip plot if required data are not available
# =========================================================================

plot_tms <- function(df, columns, y_label, title,
                     zero_line = TRUE) {

  # Check that the required columns exist
  missing_cols <- setdiff(columns, names(df))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    message("Skipping: ", title,
            " -- missing column(s): ",
            paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Keep rows where at least one logger has data
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(columns)))) > 0
    )

  # Skip if there is no data
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    message("Skipping: ", title, " -- no data available")
    return(NULL)
  }

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = TIMESTAMP)) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = .data[[columns[1]]], color = "Center"),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = .data[[columns[2]]], color = "East"),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = .data[[columns[3]]], color = "West"),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = .data[[columns[4]]], color = "North"),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = .data[[columns[5]]], color = "South"),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = color_map,
      name = "Logger"
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Timeline",
      y = y_label,
      title = title
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )+
    guides(
  color = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(linewidth = 2)
  )
)

  if (zero_line) {
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.8,
        linetype = "dashed"
      )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r, echo=F}

# =========================================================================
# PLOT 1: +15 cm AIR TEMPERATURE

  df_month,

    "TMS_N_T_1", "TMS_S_T_1"),

  "TMS +15cm Air Temperature"
```

```{R, echo = F}
# RADIATION - BIWEEKLY

for (w in sort(unique(df_month$biweek_in_month))) {
  
  dfbw <- subset(
    df_month,
    biweek_in_month == w
  )
  
  
  # Shortwave radiation: Incoming + Outgoing
  p_sw <- plot_flux_long(
    dfbw,
    cols = c(
      "SWIN_6_10_1_1_1.c",

      "pink4",
      "dodgerblue4"

    y_label = expression(Shortwave~Radiation~(W/m^2)),
    title = paste("Shortwave Radiation In/Out - Biweek", w),
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%b %d",
    site = "Toolik"
  )
 
  
  # Longwave radiation: Incoming + Outgoing
  p_lw <- plot_flux_long(
    dfbw,
    cols = c(
      "LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c",
      "LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Incoming LW",
      "Outgoing LW"
    ),
    colors = c(
      "firebrick",
      "dodgerblue"
    ),
    y_label = expression(Longwave~Radiation~(W/m^2)),
    title = paste("Longwave Radiation In/Out - Biweek", w),
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%b %d",
    site = "Toolik"
  )
  
  
  # PAR: Incoming + Reflected
  p_par <- plot_flux_long(
    dfbw,
    cols = c(
      "PPFD_7_21_1_1_1.c",
      "PPFDR_7_23_1_1_1.c"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "PPFD",
      "PPFDR"
    ),
    colors = c(
      "darkgreen",
      "purple"
    ),
    y_label = expression(PAR~(µmol~m^-2~s^-1)),
    title = paste("PAR In/Out - Biweek", w),
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%b %d",
    site = "Toolik"
  )
  
  
  # Net radiation
  p_rn <- plot_flux_single(
    dfbw,
    flux_col = "RN_6_5_1_1_1.c",
    y_label = expression(Net~Radiation~(W/m^2)),
    title = paste("Net Radiation - Biweek", w),
    color = "orange",
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%b %d",
    site = "Toolik"
  )
  
  
  # Print all radiation plots for this biweek
  print(p_sw)
  print(p_lw)
  print(p_par)
  #print(p_rn)
}
```
